messages: Can we move our team chat from Telegram to email? Too noisy there. Rosa
I set up forwarding of the invoices to info@ceramics.example, it starts on December 1. Rosa
The budget for spring is approved at 8,000 euros. Elise
Your parking permit runs out on November 30. Henk
Grandpa turns 80 on November 22, lunch is at one. Vera
Here is the plum cake recipe you asked for. Vera
Your bike is repaired and costs 74 euros. You can collect it until Friday.
The rehearsal on Wednesday starts at 20:00 in the small hall.
The tulip bulbs are in. Pick them up on Saturday.
The twelve vases can ship on November 16. Elise
Your glaze order 881 ships on Tuesday, five jars of cobalt.
We moved away from Gmail last month, so please use my new address from now on. Elise
Your stand at the fair is number 17.
The train leaves at 7:42 from platform 3.
I booked the cabin for the weekend of the 28th.
Got the address, thanks. I will send the drawings on Thursday.
The kids finish school at noon tomorrow.
Can you bring the sleeping bags on Friday?
Would you speak at our ceramics meetup on January 20?
I shared your profile with our design lead.

cases.q: can you look whether there's something new in n.falk@quiet.example
cases.fact: The bike is repaired (74 euros, collect until Friday), and/or the choir rehearsal on Wednesday at 20:00.

cases.q: kan je eens zien of er iets nieuws is op info@ceramics.example
cases.fact: The twelve vases can ship on November 16 (Elise), and/or glaze order 881 ships on Tuesday.

cases.q: tu peux voir s'il y a quelque chose de neuf sur n.falk@quiet.example ?
cases.fact: The bike is repaired (74 euros, collect until Friday), and/or the choir rehearsal on Wednesday at 20:00.

cases.q: did anything come in at nina@falkfamily.example since the weekend?
cases.fact: It says this can't be known now: the mailbox needs help (a new sign-in, in Connections), or was last read on November 6. It must not simply say that nothing came in.

cases.q: waarom zie ik niks meer van mijn familiemailbox nina@falkfamily.example?
cases.fact: The mailbox can't be read now (it needs help in Koppelingen), and/or was last read on November 6.

cases.q: Est-ce que mon LinkedIn est à jour ?
cases.fact: It was read until today around 13:00, and it is read again at 08:00 (it only reads in set hours); one of these is enough. It must not say that it failed or needs help.

cases.q: any LinkedIn messages today?
cases.fact: Omid Rahimi asked to speak at the ceramics meetup on January 20. It may add up to when LinkedIn was read or when it reads again.

cases.q: wat heeft Pavel me via Telegram laten weten?
cases.fact: The train leaves at 7:42 from platform 3, and/or the cabin is booked for the weekend of the 28th.

cases.q: Des nouvelles sur Signal ?
cases.fact: Lotte: the kids finish school at noon tomorrow, and/or bring the sleeping bags on Friday.

cases.q: what's landed lately in my ceramics shop inbox?
cases.fact: The twelve vases can ship on November 16 (Elise), and/or glaze order 881 ships on Tuesday.

cases.q: Elise m'a-t-elle écrit sur ma boîte info@ceramics.example ?
cases.fact: Yes: the twelve vases can ship on November 16, and/or to use her new address. It must not mention the budget.

cases.q: welke mails kreeg ik gisteren op n.falk@quiet.example?
cases.fact: Yesterday (November 8): the rehearsal on Wednesday at 20:00 in the small hall. It must not mention the bike as a mail of yesterday.

cases.q: could you have a look at nina@oldjob.example, anything new there?
cases.fact: nina@oldjob.example isn't connected, and it can be added in Connections.

cases.q: Peux-tu regarder s'il y a du nouveau dans nina@autre.example ?
cases.fact: nina@autre.example isn't connected, and it can be added in Connections (Connexions).

cases.q: heb ik op info@ceramics.example iets over glazuur gekregen?
cases.fact: Yes: glaze order 881 ships on Tuesday, five jars of cobalt.

cases.q: look in info@ceramics.example for anything new
cases.fact: That mailbox is Work, so it isn't in view here (Personal): pick Work or All. Nothing from that mailbox is told.

cases.q: did Tomas reply after I gave him nina@oakline.example?
cases.fact: Yes: Tomas got the address, and will send the drawings on Thursday.

cases.q: wat schreef Elise vorige week over weggaan bij Gmail?
cases.fact: Elise wrote that they moved away from Gmail last month, and to use her new address.

cases.q: Qui veut quitter Telegram pour les mails ?
cases.fact: Rosa: she asked to move the team chat from Telegram to email.

cases.q: what did Rosa say about forwarding invoices to info@ceramics.example?
cases.fact: Rosa set up forwarding of the invoices to it, and it starts on December 1.
